ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) > DATE(2020, 08, 16), ISBLANK(Subscriber_DOB__c), ISBLANK(Subscriber_Name__c), OR ( ISPICKVAL( Subscriber_Relationship__c, 'Spouse'), ISPICKVAL( Subscriber_Relationship__c, 'Child'), ISPICKVAL( Subscriber_Relationship__c, 'Other') ))
